Pomerado just launched on YC: an open-source tool that turns any website into an API or MCP server for AI agents 🔌 The team says its integrations run 2–4x faster and far cheaper than browser use, and repair themselves when sites change. #AI #AIAgents #OpenSource
https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/WSd-pomerado-the-faster-cheaper-and-more-reliable-alternative-to-browser-use
